title: Five Smooth Stones and a Sling
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A giant stood so tall and loud,
And all the soldiers hid.
But David, just a shepherd boy,
Said, "I will go!" He did.

[Chorus]
The Lord is with you, little one,
When giants come your way.
You never have to fight alone,
Just trust in God and pray.

[Verse 2]
No heavy armor, just a sling,
Five smooth stones in his hand.
He said, "I come in God's own name!"
The giant could not stand.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and rest your head,
The stars are shining bright.
The Lord who helped brave David win
Is with you through the night.

[Chorus]
mood: Marching music. A soft, steady two-step pulse walks under the voice like a small brave boy stepping toward a giant, never hurried and always sure. The sway lifts a little at the chorus, the way courage lifts a small chest. By the last verse the step slows to a rocking hush, lower and softer, until it is only a heartbeat under the closing line.
